patches.reason: Reject repeated binary-tree offsets and ancestor directory sectors in lookup and recursive traversal; allow empty directories and shared non-ancestor extents. Adds the CyclicDirectory error these guards return.
Remove the unused wax-dependent remap module; corresponds to upstream optional-remap change with the feature disabled.
Inline the library as a workspace module: rename lib.rs to mod.rs and rewrite crate:: paths to crate::xdvdfs::. mod.rs appears as a delete and add because patch renames are unsupported.
Resolve feature gates to the pinned set (std, read, write, sync on; logging, checksum, ciso_support off), delete disabled code, drop no_std, make logging macros no-ops and document the vendoring.
Drop #[repr(C)] from DirentAttributes; proc-bitfield 0.5 makes bitfields repr(transparent) and rejects the explicit repr.
Edition 2024 and workspace clippy fixes: elided lifetimes, let chains, is_multiple_of, match ergonomics, io::Error::other, test-only AVL iterator gating and rustfmt 2024 import order.
Attach the project's xdvdfs unit-test modules, port AVL tests to the rand 0.9 API and drop two futures-dependent layout tests, as the existing tree already did.
